title: DynaCrys: Crystal Generation with Dynamic Space-Group Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.07401v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The search for new crystalline materials spans an enormous compositional and structural space. Generating candidates in this space requires modeling the relationships between elemental composition, crystallographic symmetry, and crystal geometry. The space group specifies the crystal's symmetry and determines the admissible Wyckoff positions and geometric degrees of freedom; fixing it in advance prevents this global symmetry choice from being revised using information from evolving Wyckoff occupations and elemental composition. We introduce DynaCrys, the first framework for complete crystal generation in which the space group co-evolves with Wyckoff occupations and elements. We develop physics-informed space-group diffusion that explicitly incorporates crystallographic group-subgroup relations, and a legality-constrained stochastic decoder that jointly samples compatible space groups, Wyckoff occupations, and elements, followed

translated_title: DynaCrys：基于动态空间群扩散的晶体生成
translated_abstract: 寻找新型晶体材料需要在巨大的成分与结构空间中进行探索。在该空间中生成候选材料，需要对元素组成、晶体学对称性与晶体几何结构之间的关系进行建模。空间群规定了晶体的对称性，并决定了可容许的Wyckoff位置和几何自由度；若预先固定空间群，就无法利用不断演化的Wyckoff占据情况和元素组成信息来修正这一全局对称性选择。我们提出了DynaCrys，这是首个在完整晶体生成过程中空间群与Wyckoff占据及元素共同演化的框架。我们开发了物理知识引导的空间群扩散方法，显式地融入了晶体学群-子群关系，并设计了受合法性约束的随机解码器，可联合采样相互兼容的空间群、Wyckoff占据和元素……
tldr: DynaCrys是首个让空间群与Wyckoff占据及元素在生成过程中共同动态演化的完整晶体生成框架，通过显式融入晶体学群-子群关系的物理引导空间群扩散和合法性约束的随机解码器，联合采样相互兼容的空间群、Wyckoff占据与元素。
en_tdlr: DynaCrys is the first crystal generation framework in which the space group co-evolves with Wyckoff occupations and elements, employing physics-informed space-group diffusion that incorporates group-subgroup relations and a legality-constrained stochastic decoder to jointly sample compatible space groups, Wyckoff occupations, and elements.
